name: lsdyna-kagent
description: LS-DYNA K-file authoring agent: turns natural-language simulation requests into complete, solver-verified .k input decks (crash / drop / penetration / forming / ALE / SPH). Includes local keyword-manual lookup, material library, search-only literature support through a reuse-first academic-search MCP fallback, mesh generation, static deck checking, and a run-verify-fix loop against a local LS-DYNA solver.
